QUOTE: "Deny list: checked in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval. A match returns an error result and the tool never runs. The deny list is therefore enforced even when approval said yes, which makes it the one hard gate."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says ServerManager::execute checks is_denied (deny list) before routing, and calls the deny list "the one real hard gate". Its other checks (allow list, approval, anti-spiral, schema, MCP key, tier) only gate approval or feed the approval decision, not the deny list's blocking role, so the substance matches.
